name: PuntoWoo Loyalty & Digital Wallet for WooCommerce
author: NovekDev

sections.description:
PuntoWoo Loyalty & Digital Wallet for WooCommerce is a complete, self-contained customer loyalty and digital wallet platform built specifically for modern WooCommerce stores and physical retail businesses.

Turn one-time shoppers into lifelong brand advocates. PuntoWoo provides your customers with an elegant digital membership pass right in their WooCommerce My Account page—complete with a unique 10-digit card number, real-time points balance, gift card store credit, and a scannable Code 128 SVG barcode ready for any retail Point of Sale (POS) scanner.

Unlike bulky SaaS-based loyalty platforms that charge expensive monthly subscriptions and slow down your store with external API calls, PuntoWoo runs 100% natively on your WordPress database. It is ultra-fast, privacy-friendly, fully compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage), and works out-of-the-box with both classic WooCommerce checkout and modern WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

🌟 Why Store Owners Choose PuntoWoo

  • 🚀 Zero Monthly Fees & 100% Self-Contained: No external SaaS lock-in, no per-transaction charges, and no third-party data tracking. All customer points and wallet balances stay securely in your own database.
  • 💳 Virtual Membership Card in “My Account”: Customers receive an instant digital card pass showing live loyalty points and gift card balances on mobile and desktop.
  • 📲 POS & In-Store Barcode Integration: Cashiers can scan the customer’s SVG barcode directly from their smartphone screen at physical retail checkouts.
  • ⚡ Seamless Checkout Redemption: Customers can apply their wallet balance or gift card credits as an instant discount during WooCommerce checkout with one click.
  • 🎯 Automated Points & Rewards Engine: Reward points automatically whenever orders transition to completed, with custom conversion ratios (e.g., $1 spent = 1 point; 100 points = $5 discount).
  • 🔒 HPOS & Custom Order Tables Ready: Declared and battle-tested for High-Performance Order Storage in WooCommerce 8.0+ and 9.0+.
  • 📊 Admin CRM & Customer Management: View, search, and manually adjust member points, card balances, and audit history directly inside your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • 📁 AJAX Bulk CSV Importer: Migrate existing loyalty cards or import bulk gift card codes effortlessly in batches.

🚀 Key Features

1. Digital Customer Wallet & Membership Pass

  • Automatically generates a unique 10-digit digital loyalty card number upon customer registration.
  • Displays a sleek, modern membership card in My Account > Loyalty & Gift Card.
  • Live counters for both Loyalty Points and Gift Card / Store Credit Balance.
  • High-contrast vector Code 128 SVG Barcode that renders sharply on all mobile screens for optical POS scanning.

2. Dynamic Points & Rewards Engine

  • Flexible earning rates: Set custom point rewards per currency unit spent.
  • Adjustable redemption ratios: Define how many points equal $1 in store credit or discount.
  • Automatically credits points when orders are marked Processing or Completed.
  • Safe refund handling to maintain accurate points ledgers.

3. Checkout & Cart Discounts

  • Seamless discount redemption box on the WooCommerce checkout page.
  • Fully compatible with both standard shortcode checkouts and new WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.
  • Instant balance validation and AJAX cart recalculation.

4. Complete Audit Ledger & Transaction History

  • Detailed transaction history table in the customer account with 10-per-page pagination.
  • Filter by activity type: Earned Points, Wallet Redemptions, Admin Adjustments, Order Payments.
  • Full transparency reduces customer support inquiries regarding points and balances.

5. Merchant Admin CRM & Tools

  • Searchable members list with real-time balance overviews.
  • Direct manual balance adjustments (+ or -) with mandatory notes for internal accounting.
  • AJAX-powered bulk CSV importer with progress bars and error checking.
  • Clean, responsive dashboard designed to match native WordPress UX standards.

🏬 Perfect For:

  • E-Commerce Brands: Increase customer lifetime value (LTV) and encourage repeat purchases.
  • Retail Stores & Cafés: Scan customer barcodes at the cashier counter to connect online and in-person shopping.
  • Omnichannel Businesses: Unify customer rewards across your website and physical point of sale.
  • Agencies & Developers: Clean, extensible code with standard WordPress hooks and filters.

🌐 Translations & Localization

PuntoWoo is fully internationalized (caesychaos-loyalty-wallet-for-woocommerce) and ready for translation into any language via GlotPress and standard .mo/.po files.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for PuntoWoo Loyalty or upload the loyalty.zip file.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to Loyalty Program > Settings in your WordPress admin menu to configure your points conversion rates and store currency options.
  5. (Optional) Check your customer account page at My Account > Loyalty & Gift Card to view your live digital membership pass.
sections.faq:
Does PuntoWoo support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes! PuntoWoo officially declares full compatibility with HPOS (Custom Order Tables) and legacy post storage.

How do physical retail cashiers scan the customer card?

Customers simply open My Account > Loyalty & Gift Card on their smartphone. The plugin generates a clean, high-resolution SVG Code 128 barcode that standard 1D and 2D barcode scanners (USB, Bluetooth, and POS built-in scanners) can read immediately.

Does this work with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes. PuntoWoo is built to work smoothly with standard WooCommerce checkout pages as well as the new block-based Cart and Checkout blocks.

Can I import my existing customer cards or gift cards from CSV?

Yes! Navigate to Loyalty Program > Import Cards in your admin dashboard. You can upload a CSV file with customer card numbers, point balances, and gift card credits. The built-in AJAX batch importer handles large files seamlessly.

Can administrators manually grant or deduct points?

Yes. In Loyalty Program > Members, administrators can search for any member and adjust their points or gift card balance with a custom note for accounting audit records.

Are there any external API dependencies or monthly subscriptions?

No. PuntoWoo is 100% open-source and runs directly inside your WordPress database. There are no third-party cloud servers, no recurring fees, and no external tracking.

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
  • Digital wallet & member pass in WooCommerce My Account.
  • Scannable Code 128 SVG barcode for POS integration.
  • Automated points earning engine for completed orders.
  • Checkout redemption for points and gift cards.
  • Complete customer transaction audit log with pagination.
  • Merchant admin CRM and AJAX bulk CSV importer.
  • HPOS and WooCommerce Blocks compatibility.
